all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] No test checks that Restore recreates a missing parent directory for a file that existed (the MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path)) branch); the old prready/learning tests covered it. Deleting that MkdirAll passes all tests; a run that removed a file's parent directory would leave the file unrestored (rename fails with ENOENT).

[ADVISORY] Each gate's rollback wiring (Take paths, .Shared(findingsIndexPath)) is untested at gate level; the per-gate restore tests were deleted. Dropping .Shared(findingsIndexPath) or a path from Take in a gate would pass every test.

[ADVISORY] Restore renames a temp over the target and take() follows symlinks, so a symlinked output path becomes a regular file on restore (the old WriteFile wrote through the link). Only with symlinked output paths on an already-failing run: the link is replaced and the target keeps the run's content.

[ADVISORY] Restore of an existing file now needs write permission on its directory (temp+rename), where the old in-place write needed only file permission. In a read-only or full directory the restore fails silently where the old write might have succeeded.

[BUG] Restore writes to the symlink target resolved at Take time, but the gates' writers (findings.writeIndexAtomic, temp+rename) replace the symlink itself with a regular file, so the path is never restored. With a symlinked docs/metareview/FINDINGS.md a failed gate run leaves the failed run's render at the path and the link is lost; the old restore wrote to the path and restored it.

[ADVISORY] ReviewerTable writes reviewer names and titles into table cells without escaping '|' or newlines, and now emits rows for arbitrary reviewer names found in findings. A reviewer or title containing '|' or a newline could split cells in the committed log; formatting only.

[ADVISORY] Restore of a symlinked path rewrites the link target's content from the Take-time snapshot even when the run only replaced the link. If the target changed between Take and a failed run's Restore, that change is overwritten with old bytes; the old truncating restore had the same effect.

[ADVISORY] tableCell escapes '|' by prefixing a backslash without escaping existing backslashes, so a title containing a literal backslash before a pipe could render differently. A crafted title could misalign its Reviewer Results row (formatting only).

[ADVISORY] tableCell doubles every backslash, including ones inside backtick code spans in finding titles, where GFM does not process backslash escapes. A title like `C:\dir` shows a doubled backslash inside its code span in the reviewer table; cosmetic, the table stays well-formed.

[ADVISORY] tableCell treats any pipe preceded by a backslash as escaped, but GFM pairs backslashes, so a pipe after an even-length backslash run (a literal backslash then a pipe) stays bare. A title with a literal backslash immediately before a pipe splits its Reviewer Results row into an extra cell.

rejected.desc: [ADVISORY] No gate-level test asserts the rendered log contains an extra-reviewer row or the Carried forward tag; only the helpers are tested. Reverting a gate call site (fixed list only, or wrong runID) would go unnoticed.

[ADVISORY] The deleted TestRestoreSnapshotsAndRemoveEmptyDirs was the only direct caller of removeEmptyDirs in epicready. A broken pruning order would not fail any test (the deleted test only checked it did not panic).

[ADVISORY] Restore temps are named .<base>.tmp-* beside each target but only docs/metareview/.FINDINGS.md.tmp-* is gitignored. A hard crash inside the restore window leaves an untracked temp that can dirty the tree.

[ADVISORY] The Carried forward tag keys on record.RunID != runID, but a finding re-detected this run is deduped onto the existing ledger row and keeps the earlier RunID. On a --previous-run repair a freshly re-detected finding is labelled carried from an earlier run.
[ADVISORY] The rollback bullet implies learning shares the FINDINGS.md Shared exemption; learning never touches FINDINGS.md. Minor doc imprecision.

fix@0.summary: rollback: parent-dir recreation pinned; symlinked paths restored through the link; in-place write fallback when the temp cannot be created; rollback.GateOutputs is the single tested gate set (outputs + Shared FINDINGS.md) used by task-done/pr-ready/epic-ready.

fix@2.summary: Restore rewrites a symlink's target only when the run wrote through the link; a link the run replaced is relinked and its target left alone. tableCell escapes backslashes before pipes.

fix@3.summary: tableCell escapes only pipes not already escaped and leaves every other backslash as written.

fix@4.summary: tableCell escapes a pipe after an even-length backslash run (none included); a pipe after an odd run is already escaped; other backslashes untouched.
